english.title: Unlawful disclosure of information providedor obtained under regulations made under S.81 regarding records
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were in possession of information provided or obtained under regulations made under section 81 of the Transport Act 2000, namely **(..DESCRIBE INFORMATION..), disclosed that information otherwise than in accordance with section 82(2) of the Transport Act 2000, in that **(..SPECIFY HOW THE DISCLOSURE BREACHED SECTION 82(2) OF THE TRANSPORT ACT 2000..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 82(2) and (5) of the Transport Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
